a very enjoyable time spent here in lovely surroundings
Oct 2022
Hidden gem if you ask me...........at least from the small amount of reviews I see here and other sites....

Not far from Temple around the corner, this place is well worth a look...if you are seeking good food in pleasant surroundings, in an atmosphere of calm and serenity.........something most be rubbing off from the Buddhists up the road!
Lovely setting and very easy to get a seat, in what at the time i was there, was a pretty busy (but not packed) restaurant.

Ordered some battered prawns, a massive fish dish and to wash it all down some strong craft beer and a glass of wine (wines from Italy and Chile).
Food served very quickly, and with a friendly smile from the waitress, presented well too... 
All the food very tasty, the fish had a lot of meat so much that we couldn't finish it all, yes even me the barbarian from the decadent west ......

Food was very good, filling and did the job.
Beers not so much.......took ages to get a second serving, i had to ask for 5 times......yes FIVE TIMES to get a second helping of beer............which when it came was badly poured...... but I am willing to let that slide since the young waiting staff were friendly and all had nice smiles and were generally a happy bunch.

Was looking for dessert, but the restaurant does not have a set menu for afters.....which is a pity...... although we were offered ice creams and ice pops bought from the local shop....

Overall, a very enjoyable time spent here in lovely surroundings, at peace, and with good food. 
Bill was about 30 Euros, which considering i had three beers, wine, and a massive portion of food, was not that bad. 

Recommended
